resourceBoundary.overflow: Omit oldest records from the response and set truncated; never slice identifiers.
resourceBoundary.correlationPrivacy: requestId is an exact caller-controlled opaque correlation label under the existing v2 Identifier contract, not sanitized content. Callers must not place secrets or private paths in requestId; such labels remain visible to trace readers. Optional document-derived targetId omits identifiers containing colon or slash. This boundary excludes payload/path fields; it does not promise sanitization of caller correlation labels.

semantics.scope: Terminal current-identity command.document.apply, transaction begin/update/commit/cancel, history undo/redo attempts at the native authority boundary.
semantics.retry: Each admitted attempt has a sequence; identical write retries preserve the retained response revision and do not execute again. Queries retain no receipt; collisions with retained write IDs remain invalid.
semantics.identity: The response envelope identifies the instance and document. Successful document replacement clears records and restarts sequence; failed reconciliation keeps the old document fenced.
semantics.revision: The native terminal response revision, which can move backwards between a newer edit and an older retry. Transport acknowledgement is separate.
semantics.sequence: Strictly increasing within the current document, starting at one; recording stops with truncated=true if the safe integer sequence is exhausted.

examples.label: Read the same bounded native trace without retaining an inspection receipt
